reason: Since the café I already work with sent it, I might connect and take the free first collab, but I'm not paying for the pass in the first month. I already apply to campaigns on Influish, and a beta app from a small team that wants my Instagram has to show me real paid collabs first.
objection: Giving a new beta app access to my Instagram feels risky, even if they say read-only. On top of that, the café gets ₹150 when I buy and I have to make promo videos for businesses, so it starts to feel like I'm the one being sold.
would_change_my_mind: If the free first collab actually turns into a paid deal quickly and other Bengaluru creators I know say their account was fine, I'd pay the ₹499.
